description: Converts transparent or solid-background single-color PNG files and SVG files containing one embedded or local PNG into verified path-only SVG output. Removes pure-color backgrounds automatically. Uses Potrace threshold and parameter scans with alpha error metrics to preserve detailed logos, stamps, engravings, and line art. Use when the user asks to convert images to SVG, vectorize PNG, convert bitmap to true SVG, remove embedded raster data from SVG, 图片转矢量, PNG 转 SVG, 真矢量, or 位图描摹.
